notes: Startup impact: the Startup page now shows how long your last boot took (and how long to the desktop), how that compares to your recent average, and a per-entry impact chip for the apps Windows measured as slow to start — read from the same data as Task Manager's Startup impact. Plus an audit pass: steadier reverse-DNS refresh, crash-safe clipboard copy, a tighter system-report redaction, and small fixes on the Security page.
